title: Grateful Dead Live at Onondaga County War Memorial on 1973-09-17

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with clear audio but a severe pitch/tempo issue that makes the performance feel sluggish.
ai_review.review: The tape is a soundboard recording that generally sounds clean, yet it suffers from a noticeable pitch problem that slows everything down dramatically. Reviewers appreciate the overall fidelity but say the off‑pitch playback overwhelms any musical merits, leaving a mixed impression of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers focus on the same pitch/tempo flaw; one rates it 0 stars and the other 3, indicating a low‑energy show despite decent sound quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound but pitch is way off, causing an unnaturally slow playback; no other major audio issues mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The excessive slowdown makes the set feel sluggish and hampers natural flow.
